2023 Lexus IS 500 F SPORT Performance Premium
5.0L V8 | BBS Forged Wheels | Mark Levinson | Rare Breed

Let’s just get something out of the way...

This is NOT your neighbor’s Lexus.

You know the one. Quiet. Comfortable. Dependable. Leaves the neighborhood every morning without disturbing so much as a squirrel.

This Lexus apparently missed that meeting.

This 2023 Lexus IS 500 F SPORT Performance Premium has a 5.0-liter V8, rear-wheel drive and an 8-speed automatic transmission stuffed into a luxury sport sedan.

In other words, somebody at Lexus looked at a perfectly respectable IS and said:

“You know what this needs? More motor.”

And bless them for it.

5.0L V8
Rear-Wheel Drive
19" Matte Black BBS Forged Wheels
Adaptive Suspension
Mark Levinson 17-Speaker Premium Audio
Heated & Ventilated F SPORT Seats
10.3" Navigation
Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
Power Moonroof
Heated Steering Wheel
Memory Seating

And then there’s that red exterior.

Because apparently having a V8-powered Lexus wasn't getting enough attention already.

This thing has the personality of somebody showing up to a black-tie dinner wearing cowboy boots. Technically unexpected, but somehow it works.

Slide inside and everything goes right back to Lexus luxury. Heated and ventilated F SPORT seating, dual-zone climate control, navigation, moonroof and a 17-speaker Mark Levinson audio system.

Although with a 5.0L V8 sitting out front, you may occasionally turn those 17 speakers down just to listen to speaker number 18.

The one under the hood.

And THAT is what makes this car special.

The IS 500 is for the person who wants performance without driving something that screams:

“I have purchased several pieces of carbon fiber from the internet.”

It's sophisticated.

It's comfortable.

It's luxurious.

But poke the accelerator, and it becomes abundantly clear that this Lexus has been eating its vegetables.

You get the everyday usability you'd expect from a premium Lexus sedan, wrapped around the kind of old-school formula enthusiasts absolutely love:

Big V8. Rear-wheel drive. Sport sedan.

No complicated explanation necessary.

It'll take you to dinner.

It'll take you to work.

It'll take you on a road trip.

And it'll happily remind you on the entrance ramp that you did not buy the four-cylinder.



The matte black BBS forged wheels give it exactly the right stance, while the adaptive suspension helps balance performance with the comfort you actually want when you're not pretending the highway entrance ramp is Turn Three at Daytona.

This isn't the Lexus you buy because you simply need transportation.

This is the Lexus you buy because V8-powered luxury sedans like this deserve to be enjoyed.

So if you've been driving a Lexus V8 and wondering what you're supposed to replace it with...

You might want to come see this one before somebody else has the same idea.

Because you can always find another luxury sedan.

Finding another one with this much personality?

Well...that's where things get interesting.

Come see this 2023 Lexus IS 500 F SPORT Performance Premium at Jim Hudson Cadillac of Augusta.

Bring your driver's license.

Bring your trade.

And maybe use your inside voice when you tell your spouse you were “just going to look.”

We won't tell.

This used luxury sports sedan boasts 65,376 miles and packs a punch with a 4.4-liter twin-turbo V8 delivering 600 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Equipped with an 8-speed automatic transmission and AWD, it offers impressive performance and handling. This M5 comes loaded with advanced tech features including Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, satellite radio, and a premium 14-speaker sound system complemented by a 10.2-inch infotainment touchscreen. The vehicle also features a suite of driver-assistance options such as a backup camera, blind spot monitor, collision warning, cross traffic alert, head-up display, and hands-free liftgate, making every drive safer and more convenient. The interior boasts leather seats with memory settings, heated and ventilated options, a rear sunshade, rear heated seats, and interior accents that enhance luxury. Additional features include keyless entry, push start, rear A/C, WiFi hotspot, and navigation with real-time traffic updates, ensuring comfort and connectivity on every journey. Upgrades like 20-inch M Double-Spoke Black Wheels and the Driving Assistance Plus and Executive Packages add to the vehicle’s sporty appeal and convenience.

This 2019 BMW M5 also prioritizes safety and security with dual front knee airbags, traffic sign recognition, and premium brakes for confident stopping power. Parking sensors at the front and rear, along with parking assistance systems like Surround View and Active Park Distance Control, simplify parking in tight spaces. The vehicle’s regenerative braking system, 4-wheel ABS, and cornering brake control further enhance safety, while auto-locking power door locks provide added security.

2019 BMW M5 Safety and Security Features

This model includes essential safety features such as dual front knee airbags and traffic sign recognition to assist with safe driving. Premium brakes ensure reliable stopping performance, complemented by front and rear parking sensors and parking assistance systems that make maneuvering easier. The regenerative braking system helps optimize energy use, while 4-wheel ABS and cornering brake control boost stability during braking. Auto-locking power door locks provide security, giving peace of mind when parked or away from the vehicle.

2019 BMW M5 Entertainment and Technology Features

The M5 is equipped with a 10.2-inch infotainment touchscreen that offers HD radio, real-time traffic navigation, and voice-activated controls for hands-free calling and radio. The premium sound system features 14 speakers, including two subwoofers with a total output of 600 watts, and surround sound at 5.1 channels, delivering an immersive audio experience. Additional features include a surround sound system, HD radio, and touch screen display, ensuring entertainment and connectivity are always at your fingertips.

2019 BMW M5 Performance Features

Under the hood, this BMW M5 features an active suspension system with electronic control and driver-adjustable ride control, allowing customization of handling and comfort. The full-time 4WD system provides excellent traction and stability, while a limited slip differential at the rear enhances cornering performance. The vehicle also includes auto start/stop technology to improve efficiency and a suspension control system that adapts to driving conditions, ensuring a dynamic and responsive ride.

Experience the thrill of driving a 2021 Tesla Model S Plaid, a luxury electric sedan that combines cutting-edge technology with impressive performance. With 67,230 miles on the odometer, this used Tesla offers a remarkable blend of power and efficiency, boasting up to 1020 horsepower and an electric range of 390 miles per charge. Its all-wheel-drive system ensures confident handling in various conditions, while features like adaptive cruise control, collision warning, and blind spot monitoring enhance safety. Inside, you'll find heated and rear heated seats, a sunroof/moonroof, and a premium 17-inch touchscreen infotainment system that keeps you connected, entertained, and in control. Keyless entry, memory seats, Bluetooth, satellite radio readiness, and rear A/C provide comfort and convenience for everyday driving.

This Tesla Model S Plaid is equipped with a suite of advanced safety features designed to protect occupants and assist drivers. Traffic sign recognition with adaptive speed limiting keeps you aware of road signs, while dual front knee airbags and a comprehensive camera system—including front and rear cameras—enhance situational awareness. Parking sensors at the front and rear facilitate easier maneuvering, complemented by a regenerative braking system that maximizes energy efficiency. Dash cameras record front, rear, and side views, providing added security. The vehicle also includes ABS on all four wheels, ensuring stable braking performance in emergency situations.

2021 Tesla Model S Safety and Security Features

The safety package features traffic sign recognition combined with adaptive speed limiting to help maintain safe driving speeds. Dual front knee airbags and dual front airbags provide essential occupant protection. The front camera system offers enhanced visibility, while front and rear parking sensors assist with precise parking maneuvers. The regenerative braking system recovers energy during deceleration, improving efficiency. Dash cameras record from front, rear, and side angles, offering peace of mind. Four-wheel ABS ensures reliable stopping power in all conditions, making this Model S a secure choice.

2021 Tesla Model S Entertainment and Technology Features

The Tesla Model S Plaid boasts a massive 17-inch infotainment touchscreen, delivering intuitive control over media, navigation, and vehicle settings. Smartphone app compatibility allows you to use your phone as a key and remotely start the engine or precondition the cabin via the Tesla App. The sound system features 11 speakers and 560 watts, providing high-quality audio for all passengers. Wi-Fi hotspot capability keeps you connected on the go, while voice-operated HD radio ensures a variety of entertainment options. The touchscreen interface simplifies access to all features, making every drive enjoyable and connected.

2021 Tesla Model S Performance Features

This Model S Plaid delivers exceptional performance with an electric motor that provides up to 390 miles per charge, ensuring long-distance capability. The car features active air suspension with electronic suspension control and driver-adjustable ride and height settings, offering a smooth and customizable ride. Its lithium-ion battery pack supplies reliable power, while self-leveling pneumatic suspension maintains optimal ride quality. Charging the battery via 240V takes approximately 15 hours, making overnight charging practical. The rear suspension includes pneumatic springs for enhanced ride comfort and handling, delivering a dynamic driving experience that matches its impressive acceleration and range.
